datasets.purpose: Acutely Food Insecure Population Estimates in different scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) surveys across Mauritania to estimate acutely food insecure populations under different scenarios. Population estimates were aggregated and classified to produce most likely food insecurity impact figures for 2020, reflecting drought-driven humanitarian needs.
